issues: The UI primary flow test fails: the link "Don’t have an account? Sign up" on the Sign‑In screen is not found. Ensure the element is rendered with accessibilityRole="link" and a matching accessible name (e.g., use a proper link component or a TouchableOpacity with the correct role and label).

TypeScript configuration error: tsconfig.json sets "moduleResolution": "node16" but "module" remains "commonjs", causing TS5110. Update tsconfig.json to use a compatible configuration (e.g., set both "moduleResolution" and "module" to "node16" or change "moduleResolution" to "node" and adjust imports accordingly).
feedback: The backend tests all pass, but the UI flow and TS config errors block the overall solution. Fix the accessibility of the sign‑in navigation link and correct the TypeScript compiler options so the project compiles without errors.
